video_caption: The video opens with a top-down view of a black iPad in a case, centered on a white textured surface, surrounded by a blue plush toy, yellow plush toy, green plush toy, and colored pencils. Text overlay reads "HARDWARE". A person's hands, wearing a light grey long-sleeved top, then open the black case to reveal a tablet displaying a purple lock screen with the time "4:12", date "Sunday, April 18", a background image of a cloudy sky with a crescent moon, and the text "[spring day]". The tablet is then laid flat, and text appears at the bottom: "2017 10.5 INCH IPAD PRO". The scene briefly cuts to a close-up of the black iPad case, revealing the "ProCase" brand name embossed on the bottom right corner, before returning to the wider shot where the person again opens the case to display the iPad, now showing "4:14" on the lock screen. The person then adjusts the case to prop the iPad upright. Finally, a white Apple Pencil is shown being balanced horizontally between the index fingers of the person's hands, in front of the propped-up iPad.

The video opens at 00:02 with a top-down view of an Apple Pencil held horizontally between two fingers, positioned above a dark-screened iPad lying on a white surface. Around the iPad are three plush toys: a blue Stitch character on the left, a yellow character with white hands and feet at the top right, and a green character with a pink bow and a yellow 'X' for an eye on the bottom right. The text "APPLE PENCIL" appears at the bottom of the screen. At 00:15, the camera zooms in on the iPad screen as the person uses the Apple Pencil to tap the matte-finished screen, which reflects some light. The text "SUPERSHIELDZ MATTE SCREEN PROTECTOR" is displayed. The person then removes the Apple Pencil and the shot returns to the wider view at 00:28, showing colored pencils (red, green, and dark green) at the bottom left. At 00:31, the person picks up a white iPhone in a dark case, holding it up to show its glossy screen, with the iPad still visible in the background. The text "VIEW OF MY IPHONE GLASS SCREEN FOR COMPARISON" clarifies the purpose of this shot. Finally, at 00:39, the scene transitions to a white binder with a page full of handwritten notes and diagrams in black ink with red accents. The glowing text "DiGITAL > PAPER" is overlaid on the notes, and a hand is seen turning the page.

The video begins with a person's hand flipping through pages of a white, ring-bound notebook filled with academic notes, densely handwritten in black ink and extensively color-coded with highlights in pink, green, yellow, and blue, often featuring diagrams and bullet points. At one point, a yellow sticky note with handwritten text including "strategy to control gene expression" is placed on a page. The note-taking style transitions from entirely handwritten pages to pages containing numerous smaller, printed notes arranged in columns, before returning to the familiar handwritten format. The video then briefly shows a screen with the word "ANYWAY" in white text on a peach background, before transitioning to a person's hand using a white stylus to tap the "GoodNotes" app icon on an iPad, which displays a light blue cloud-themed wallpaper with the text "SOFTWARE" overlaid on the screen.

In this video segment, a person with a white long-sleeved shirt is shown interacting with a black tablet using a white stylus, against a background of white fabric, plush toys, and colored pencils, all overlaid with white star outlines. From 0:04 to 0:10, text appears on the tablet screen: "1. CONVENIENCE", "2. SIMPLICITY", and "3. EASY ORGANIZATION", indicating the advantages of using the app. The person points to various documents and folders on the tablet's file management interface. At 0:10, the word "ORGANIZATION" appears centrally on the screen, highlighted with a white glow. The person then demonstrates the app's organization features by navigating through folders. They tap on a "biochem" folder, revealing sub-folders like "biochem lab," "Biochem lecture syllabus F2020," "biochem pract," and "exam one." Further taps open the "exam one" folder, showing various lecture slides and notes, then the "exam two" folder with similar content. Finally, returning to the main "Documents" view, the person taps a "+" icon, which brings up a menu with options such as "Notebook," "Folder," "Image," "Scan Documents," "Take Photo," "Import," and "QuickNote," demonstrating how new content can be added. The person taps "Import" as the segment ends.

A person wearing a gray long-sleeved shirt is shown using a white Apple Pencil to write on an iPad. The iPad screen displays a "notes" application, and a menu is open, highlighting the "Ball Pen" option. The person is actively drawing a wavy black line on the white digital paper. Below the iPad, the text "BALL PEN" appears on a peach-colored background, identifying the selected pen type.

A person's hands, wearing a light grey long-sleeved top, are seen interacting with a dark grey tablet, which is lying on a white, textured surface. To the left of the tablet is a light blue plush pencil case (shaped like Stitch from Lilo & Stitch), and to the right are a pink plush toy with a yellow sticky note on its head and a green plush toy with a black cross stitched on its head. The person uses a white stylus (with a silver band) to navigate through a digital document, which appears to be lecture notes in PDF format. Initially, a grid of multiple small pages (thumbnails) is shown, then the person selects a page titled "Amino Acids, Peptides, Proteins." The notes scroll to display sections like "Main Agents of Biological Function" for proteins, "Amino Acids: Building Blocks of Protein," and then a diagram of a generalized amino acid structure. On-screen text reads, "WHAT I'M SAYING MAKES NO SENSE LOL I'LL SHOW U IN A BIT." The notes continue to show details about amino acid chirality, a chemical structure for Lysine with atom naming conventions (alpha, beta, gamma, delta, epsilon carbons), and a comparison of L and D amino acids, with a handwritten note in the margin stating, "PROTEINS ARE ONLY L AMINO ACIDS." The notes then categorize amino acids based on their R substituents: "Nonpolar, aliphatic," "Aromatic," "Polar, uncharged," "Positively charged," and "Negatively charged." Handwritten annotations in pink/red appear, including "# need to know all aa structures, name, 3 letters + 1 letter codes" and "# exam: can you write 2 examples of nonpolar aliphatic aa." The layout of the notes is shown in a two-column "lecture style" format. Finally, the person puts down the stylus, picks up a small stack of colored pencils, and the tablet screen transitions to a blank page with a title bar, as the text "LECTURE STYLE NOTES" appears prominently on the screen.

The video opens with an overhead shot of a person wearing a light grey long-sleeved shirt, using an Apple Pencil to write on an iPad lying on a white surface. The iPad screen displays a note-taking application with a grid paper background and a toolbar at the top showing various pen and highlighter options. Three plush toys are visible around the iPad: a blue cat-like figure on the left, a yellow character with a pink sticky note on its head on the top right, and a green creature with a stitched 'X' for an eye on the bottom right. White text, "LECTURE STYLE NOTES," is overlaid on the screen. The person begins writing "genetics" on the iPad, and after completing the word, they use a highlighter tool to give it a purple background, creating a highlighted title for their notes.

A person's right hand, wearing a light gray long-sleeved top, holds a white stylus (Apple Pencil) and writes notes on a black tablet (likely an iPad) lying flat on a white, textured surface. The note-taking application on the tablet screen displays "genetics" highlighted in purple as a main topic, followed by bullet points and sub-points. The person writes "genetics' main concerns of field are heredity v" at the 0:08 mark, then adds the date "4/19/2020" in the top right corner. Subsequently, they add sub-points using dashes, writing "- classical = units of heredity" and then "- molecular = segment of DNA that produces a product". The video continues with the person adding another main bullet point "• fields of genetics", under which they write "- population" and then "- transmission" as sub-points using dashes, demonstrating a structured note-taking system. The tablet's interface shows various pen tools and navigation options in a top toolbar, and the main writing area has a light grid pattern. A blurred light blue object is visible in the background to the top left.

The video segment displays a top-down view of a study setup on a white, rumpled blanket, bordered by a soft peach color. On the left, a light blue plush pencil case and a stack of red, green, and blue colored pencils are visible. In the center, a person's hand, wearing light-colored sleeves, holds a stylus and scrolls through digital notes on a black tablet resting flat on the blanket. A white stylus is magnetically attached to the right side of the tablet. The tablet screen shows handwritten notes with various chemical structures, diagrams, and equations, some highlighted in pink and others drawn in a different color like blue or red, consistent with the speaker's narration about highlighting important information and adding extra clarification. Overlaid on the video, the text "PREMADE NOTES" is visible, indicating that the displayed notes are pre-prepared. To the right, a small pink plush toy with a yellow sticky note on its head and a green plush toy are also on the blanket.

The video opens with a top-down view of a person's right hand, with light pink nail polish and rings, scrolling through extensive handwritten digital notes on a black tablet. The tablet rests on a white, slightly wrinkled surface surrounded by colorful plush toys (a blue one on the left, a green one on the bottom right, and a yellow and pink one on the top right) and a few colored pencils (red, orange, green). Overlaid white text reads "NOTES THAT DON T WORK FOR ME", indicating the video's theme. The notes on the tablet are dense with text, diagrams (like a virus structure and reproductive anatomy), and some highlighted sections, showcasing detailed academic content. The person continues to scroll through various pages, which appear to be from a biology or anatomy textbook. The scene then transitions to a closer view, showing the person holding the tablet vertically, displaying a page titled "biology ch 3: embryogenesis + devel" with intricate text and diagrams illustrating embryonic development. The speaker explains that this type of note-taking was time-consuming and ineffective for them, leading them to switch to Anki flashcards for more practical and efficient learning.

In this video segment, a person's hand, wearing a gray long-sleeved top, holds a white Apple Pencil and is actively writing on a tablet, likely an iPad. The tablet displays handwritten notes with a title highlighted in purple that reads "yo genesis + devel." (meaning "oogenesis + development"), followed by black text detailing information about secondary oocytes and fertilization. The background features a soft white surface, adorned with a blue stuffed animal to the left of the tablet, colored pencils (red, green, blue) beneath the hand, and various other out-of-focus items including a pink object, a white object, and a green stuffed toy with a black "X" on its face to the right.
